content.comment_body: Hello, I have an old [product_name] with article number [article_no]. I can't seem to find the specific datasheet for this model. Does anyone know if it supports fast inputs? I'm working on synchronizing two motors by counting pulses from inductive sensors, around 20 pulses per second. I've tested my program, but not all pulses are being registered.
Refer to the attached PDF. The [article_no] variant does not have fast input capability. You can download the full manual from [url]: [document] Edition 1997.

analysis.insight_summary: The user struggled to find documentation for a particular [product_name] variant and was unsure about fast input support. When attempting to use the device for pulse counting with an inductive sensor, they encountered missed counts, highlighting the module's limitations in applications requiring fast signal detection.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the module should reliably count fast pulses for synchronizing motor signals at 20 Hz and desires clear documentation regarding hardware features.
